messages.subject: Lyra - investor side letter
messages.plaintextBody:
James - separate from Beacon: Marisdale have come back on the Project Lyra investor side letter and want the information rights extended to quarterly board packs. Can you take a quick look tomorrow before I reply to Hargrove? Not urgent for tonight.

Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
